biography.plain_text: Ted Turner was an American media entrepreneur who expanded his inherited billboard business into Turner Broadcasting and founded CNN, pioneering round-the-clock television news. He also created the TBS Superstation and built entertainment networks before the Time Warner merger. His philanthropy included establishing the United Nations Foundation with a billion-dollar commitment.
biography.html: Ted Turner was an American media entrepreneur who expanded his inherited billboard business into Turner Broadcasting and founded CNN, pioneering round-the-clock television news. He also created the TBS Superstation and built entertainment networks before the Time Warner merger. His philanthropy included establishing the United Nations Foundation with a billion-dollar commitment.

confidence.reason: Direct primary accounts and corroborating reporting support each material claim independently of wealth inference.

long_biography.plain_text:
American entrepreneur Ted Turner combined commercial bison ranching with efforts to restore native wildlife. His ranches used grazing, hunting, fishing and limited timber production to support the land's management. He also helped create a research institute studying sustainable ranching, donating land to put its work into practice.

As a competitive sailor, Turner assembled an America's Cup crew from sailors he already knew through offshore racing, including tactician Gary Jobson and trimmer Robbie Doyle. He steered the team to a clean sweep of the 1977 defence and won the storm-struck Fastnet Race two years later.
